title: Adult Social Care and Healthcare
summary: Build practical skills for working in adult social care and healthcare, from supporting people day to day to developing your skills for a senior care role.
description: Explore qualifications that introduce the knowledge and values used in adult social care, or prepare you for further study in healthcare. We help you understand what each route involves and whether it suits your experience and goals.
qualifications: Access to HE Diploma in Nursing and Midwifery

title: English and Mathematics
summary: Build confidence in reading, writing and everyday maths. Explore Functional Skills options that can support your next step into work or further study.
description: English and mathematics qualifications are often needed for further study and many jobs. We help you find a suitable level and understand how these qualifications fit with your wider plans.

title: Digital Skills
summary: Learn to use email, online services and everyday software with confidence at work, in study and at home.
description: Digital skills support learning, job searching and everyday tasks. We help you explore courses that build practical confidence with technology at a pace that suits you.

title: Business and Management
summary: Explore courses that develop your skills in business administration, team leadership and management.
description: Business and management qualifications can support progression into supervisory and leadership roles. We help you compare levels and understand the entry requirements for each.

title: Early Childhood Education
summary: Explore training for working with young children and learn how to support their development, learning and wellbeing.
description: Early childhood education qualifications focus on how young children learn and develop. We help you understand the options and what each level may lead to.
qualifications: Early Childhood Education Diplomas: Levels 4 and 5

title: Education and Training
summary: Explore courses that help you plan learning sessions, support learners and develop your teaching or training skills.
description: If you are interested in teaching or training others, an introductory teaching qualification is a common first step. We help you understand what is involved and how to prepare.
qualifications: Level 3 Award in Education and Training
